analysis.reasonEn: Current price $658.87 approaches the lower Bollinger Band at $644.30. RSI at 39.6 attempts a bounce after entering oversold territory. However, MACD histogram worsens to -2.6944, indicating persistent selling pressure. ADX at 27.1 suggests a trend is forming, but -DI (40.8) significantly exceeds +DI (13.3), showing downside bias. Volume ratio of 0.84 relative to the 5-day average indicates subdued trading, lowering confidence in trend reversal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear direction and ongoing selling pressure.
